config.recovery: native autocomplete_valid for incomplete output, deterministic completion; count all costs/statuses

config.candidate_selection: state variant must improve macro pass@2 by>=0.02 over matching root/history/iid development and have>=one post-divergence shared sufficient-state node; maximum minimum gain, ties lower full mean wall then first then temperature0.5; no relaxation
config.independent_gate: same frozen state configuration versus ALL matched iid/root/history; absolute macro pass@2 gain>=0.02, paired 95% case-cluster bootstrap lower bound>0 (10000 draws, seed319999); full wall and CPU per correct request no greater than each control; failures included
config.additional_controls: native deterministic temperature0 first response with its full costs; same task, counted separately on quality/cost frontier, no theorem against a different marginal law
config.pilot: first development seed across ALL selected16 inputs and ALL state configurations and matched history/root/iid; first-output bitwise equality, all statuses retained; if no extra reunions, may stop only as negative screening, not confirmation
config.refusal_policy: input/model/grammar/resource refusals and incomplete/invalid JSON remain records; never replace selected cases or tune on heldout gold
config.cost_policy: all grammar/prompt preparation, cache cold/warm, CPU/GPU transfers, model queries and actual new forwards, noise/table coordination, parsing/recovery/verification/output included; unique-cache counts cannot stop other labels
